name: application-service-reminder-row
title: Service Reminder Row
description: Maintenance-reminder row with a due-mileage progress bar and a Schedule action, distinct from application-sync-status-row since it tracks mileage-based service intervals rather than data-sync recency.
useWhen: Showing a single upcoming maintenance item with how much mileage remains before it's due.
Listing multiple maintenance reminders with overdue, upcoming, and ok urgency states.
Offering a Schedule action per reminder in a vehicle or fleet dashboard.
avoidWhen: The reminder isn't mileage-based — a plain date-based reminder row may be simpler.
You are tracking data-sync recency rather than vehicle maintenance — use application-sync-status-row instead.
Only one maintenance item ever needs tracking — the single-row variant is enough; skip the list variant's extra structure.
responsiveBehavior: Both variants have a fixed max width; the list variant's rows keep the service name and Schedule button on one line down to narrow tablet widths.
accessibility: The progress bar in Variant 1 carries role='progressbar' with aria-valuenow/min/max reflecting real mileage values.
Urgency (overdue/upcoming/ok) is communicated through both button color and text label, not color alone.
The overdue action is labeled 'Schedule now' rather than just 'Schedule', giving the urgency a textual cue as well as a color one.

variants.title: Single reminder with progress
variants.description: Single maintenance-item row with a due-mileage progress bar and a Schedule action.
accessibility: aria-valuenow/min/max on the progress bar reflect the real current, last-service, and due mileage values.

variants.title: Single reminder with progress (Dark)
variants.description: Single maintenance-reminder row adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Progress bar fill and text contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Reminder list with urgency
variants.description: List of maintenance reminders with overdue, upcoming, and ok urgency states, each with its own Schedule action.
accessibility: The overdue item's button text ('Schedule now') and red color together signal urgency, not color alone.

variants.title: Reminder list with urgency (Dark)
variants.description: Maintenance-reminder list adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Urgency text and button contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds for every state.
